headline: The tech-stock rout spread to Asia on Friday, with South Korea's market halted after an 8% drop, while bitcoin held near $76,000 ahead of the US jobs report at 20:30 Bangkok time.

market.asOf: Bitcoin and Solana from CoinGecko, Ether from CoinMarketCap, read about 03:58-04:00 UTC Fri 6 Nov. Use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: Sources disagree: Alternative.me's Crypto Fear & Greed Index page showed 50 (Neutral) at about 03:57 UTC; KuCoin's 6 Nov daily report put the index at 28, down from 50.

stories.title: Tech selloff spreads to Asia; bitcoin holds near $76,000 after Thursday's drop
stories.summary: Thursday's slide in chip and AI stocks hit Asia on Friday morning. South Korea's main index fell so fast that trading was halted. Bitcoin, which fell with US tech stocks on Thursday, did not fall much further in Asian hours.
points: South Korea's KOSPI fell 8.55% to 4,923.47 and Japan's Nikkei fell 6.2% to 57,288.91, per TradingKey; a circuit breaker paused Korean trading at 9:03am local time, per BeInCrypto.
Bitcoin's low on Thursday was $75,463 on Bitstamp, its lowest since 16 September, per KuCoin News.
Forced closing of leveraged bets: The Block reported nearly $1.1B over 24 hours; Crypto-Economy counted $1.053B, of which $926.8M were bets on rising prices.
On Wall Street, the Nasdaq fell 5.5% and the S&P 500 4.3% on Thursday; the Nasdaq 100's 6.4% drop was its worst since March 2020, per CoinDesk.

stories.title: Binance hack: frozen-fund recovery is still at the discussion stage on Arbitrum and Polygon
stories.summary: Getting back stolen funds frozen on other blockchains means slow, public governance processes. Neither the Arbitrum nor the Polygon request has reached a vote yet. US bank supervisors have also started asking banks questions.
points: About $6.3B was stolen, attributed to North Korea's TraderTraitor unit; Binance says it froze or intercepted about $2.85B, per Bitcoin Magazine.
Fed and OCC supervisors began contacting US banks on Monday about unusual activity, per Bitcoin Magazine, citing Reuters.
Binance asked Arbitrum's DAO to release 8,425.997 ETH and 74.56M ARB; the request is at the forum stage and the process takes about 49 days, per crypto.news.
A Polygon proposal would hard-fork the chain to move 70.49M POL (about $6.8M) back to Binance and Polymarket; it needs testnet trials first and has no date, per Cointelegraph.

stories.title: After the midterms: Democrats reshape the crypto bill push while regulators keep moving
stories.summary: With Democrats' midterm wins, the CLARITY Act looks harder to pass, and House Democrats are discussing their own bill. Meanwhile agencies are writing rules without Congress, and states keep suing prediction markets.
points: House Democrats are discussing expanding Rep. Maxine Waters' Crypto Investor Consumer Bill of Rights into a broader market-structure bill with more power for the SEC, per Decrypt.
Stand With Crypto's endorsed candidates won 27 of 45 races, with 12 lost and 6 undecided, per Decrypt.
The SEC's proposed rules for broker-dealers holding crypto went to the White House regulatory review office on 3 Nov, per The Defiant.
Arkansas sued Kalshi on 4 Nov, calling the prediction market an illegal gambling platform, per the state attorney general.

briefs.title: Bitcoin ETFs: last full count is 4 Nov
briefs.summary: US spot bitcoin ETFs took in a net $74.6M on 4 Nov after three days of outflows; FBTC gained $236.7M while IBIT lost $201.2M. Figures for 5 Nov were not yet out, per the tftc.io tracker.

briefs.title: Base speeds up to 200ms blocks
briefs.summary: Coinbase's Base network deployed its Denim upgrade, cutting block times to 200 milliseconds and replacing Flashblocks, per The Block.

briefs.title: Hyperliquid priority fees hit a record
briefs.summary: Daily priority fees reached a record $521K, 12.7% of platform revenue that day, per KuCoin's daily report.

briefs.title: SEC custody proposal: comments due 7 Dec
briefs.summary: The SEC's proposal would let investment advisers hold crypto with state trust companies; comments are due 7 Dec, per a Harvard Law School Forum summary.

briefs.title: American Bitcoin falls despite a profit
briefs.summary: The miner reported a $126M quarterly profit, but its stock fell 17% in Thursday's selloff, per The Block.

briefs.title: Hyperliquid Strategies seeks CFTC broker status
briefs.summary: The company filed to become a CFTC-registered futures broker and posted $13.3M in quarterly revenue, per The Block.

briefs.title: Samsung Wallet adds USDC accounts
briefs.summary: Eligible US Galaxy users can open USDC accounts on Solana inside Samsung Wallet, except in New York, per The Block.
